_comment: Brand kit for Athletes Acceleration. Keys under `tags` map a layer's field name (its `tag`) to the value that replaces the layer's content at fill time. Built incrementally — add tags as templates surface them. Campaign/location overlays (data/campaign.*.json, data/location.*.json) override these per launch.
_note: Identity + brand tokens. Color/font tokens below are byte-exact to templates/multi-sport-foundations/_helpers.jsx and the motion `const RED` literals — they are the FALLBACK values, so AA renders identically while any other brand kit overrides. brand_tint is intentionally absent: AA's photo tints are rgba red at varying alpha (cluster-8/8a/11/12), which a solid token can't represent; franchisee tints are recolored RGB-component-wise at clone time instead.

tags.guarantee: +1 mph speed. +3" vertical. 90 days. Or your training is on us.
